get.description: Survivors, stamps and bystander plan for every beat, derived from the fate script. Ready at creation.

Server-Sent Events: a status snapshot, bible/beat/chronicle events and 'complete', then 'comic'
status events; the stream ends after the comic is final (ready, failed or off).

character.title: Character
character.description: Character id, or null for a crowd summary.

headline.title: Headline
headline.description: For example 'Davido is OUT' or 'Davido RETURNS'.

cause.title: Cause
cause.description: For example 'poisoned by the goblet meant for Caesar'.

Announcement.title: Announcement
Announcement.description: A stamp built from the fate script alone; the stage and the comic show the same words.

statement.title: Statement
statement.description: Plain-language, role-aware description of what happens in the beat.

survivors_before.title: Survivors Before
survivors_before.description: Participant ids in the contest at the start of the beat.

survivors_after.title: Survivors After
survivors_after.description: Participant ids in the contest at the end of the beat.

bystanders.title: Bystanders
bystanders.description: Participant ids planned to appear without a role in this scene.

ghost.title: Ghost
ghost.description: The one planned ghost of the show, if it appears in this beat, else null.

before_line.title: Before Line
before_line.description: Index of the line this caption box precedes; len(lines) means at the end.

id.title: Id
id.description: Stable id: p01..p40 by canonical position, old_king, or npc_<role>.

is_old_king.title: Is Old King
is_old_king.description: True for the Old King, whether participant or not.

epilogue.title: Epilogue
epilogue.description: At most 120 words, naming the new monarch.

blurb.title: Blurb
blurb.description: Back-cover blurb, two or three sentences, no spoilers of the winner.

ComicInfo.title: ComicInfo
ComicInfo.description: Public comic status. The file's location on disk is never sent to the browser.

beat.title: Beat
beat.description: Index of the beat that eliminates them.

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: One sentence: why they leave, consistent with the beat facts. Names them.

old_king.title: Old King
old_king.description: Character id of the Old King.

winner.title: Winner
winner.description: Character id of the participant who will be crowned.

FateScript.title: FateScript
FateScript.description: The complete, fixed story timeline. Never contains the seed.

members.title: Members
members.description: Character ids of the house members.

speaker.title: Speaker
speaker.description: Character id from the cast, or 'narrator'.

want.title: Want
want.description: One line: what this character wants in the story, from archetype and house only.

is_mad_king.title: Is Mad King
is_mad_king.description: True when no previous winner was given.

is_participant.title: Is Participant
is_participant.description: True when the previous winner also competes.

text.title: Text
text.description: Short comic sound word in capitals, e.g. SHINK!

id.title: Id
id.description: Machine-readable fact id, for example 'betrayed' or 'house:goat'.

text.title: Text
text.description: Plain English hint that does not name the winner.

SceneScript.title: SceneScript
SceneScript.description: A validated scene, shared by the live stage and the comic. Never changes once delivered.

title.title: Title
title.description: Title of this week's show, like a comic issue title.

prophecy.title: Prophecy
prophecy.description: The seer's prophecy, two or three cryptic lines, never naming anyone.

motifs.title: Motifs
motifs.description: Two to five recurring images or running jokes.

beats.title: Beats
beats.description: One-sentence synopsis for every beat index.

threads.title: Threads
threads.description: One to four story threads linking setups to payoffs.

participants.title: Participants
participants.description: Participant names, one per entry; blanks are ignored.

old_king.title: Old King
old_king.description: Previous winner; empty means the Mad King.

created_at.title: Created At
created_at.description: Local date and time the show was created (the comic's issue date).

ShowSession.title: ShowSession
ShowSession.description: Public view of a show session. The seed itself is never included.

line.title: Line
line.description: Index of the line during which it happens.

title.title: Title
title.description: Short name of the thread, e.g. 'The Faceless contract on Aino'.

beats.title: Beats
beats.description: Beat indexes the thread runs through, ascending: setup first, payoff last.

summary.title: Summary
summary.description: One sentence linking the setup to its payoff.

Storyline.title: Storyline
Storyline.description: Deterministic story facts derived from the fate script: no LLM, never changes for a show.
